scripts.dev:api: uv run --directory apps/api flask --app corkathon_api.app:create_app run --debug --port 5001
scripts.start: bun run build && uv run --directory apps/api python -m corkathon_api.serve
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && bun run --filter web typecheck && uv run --directory apps/api mypy .
scripts.lint: eslint . --max-warnings 0 && bun scripts/lint-slop.ts && uv run --directory apps/api ruff check .
scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format .
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --directory apps/api ruff format --check .
scripts.test: bun test ./scripts ./apps/web/src ./apps/web/dev && uv run --directory apps/api pytest
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test && bun run e2e && bun run build
